cases.prompt: Convert a scanned chapter into a native PDF; invisible OCR is explicitly prohibited.
forbidden_behaviors: Return a full-page scan with hidden OCR
Place visible text over unchanged raster glyphs

cases.prompt: Repair doubled text and inconsistent body/code size and darkness in an existing candidate.
forbidden_behaviors: Rebuild all verified pages
Fit every line independently

cases.prompt: Check every page and every word against the scan, not a sample.
forbidden_behaviors: Claim completion from representative sampling

cases.prompt: Correct one source-confirmed code line without disturbing already checked pages.
required_behaviors: Replace the smallest object or page
forbidden_behaviors: Regenerate the entire book

cases.prompt: Learn a reconstruction method from a 648-page scan and its checked native counterpart without leaking viewed pages into validation or test.
required_behaviors: Force all previously viewed pages into training
forbidden_behaviors: Tune on validation pages
Browse test pages before choices are frozen

cases.prompt: A PDF has a full-page image on every page and extractable text consisting primarily of a repeated watermark. Classify it before reconstruction.
required_behaviors: Measure image coverage and extractable text
forbidden_behaviors: Call the book native because pdftotext returns a watermark

cases.prompt: Select an OCR hypothesis generator for dense Chinese/Scala technical pages when one backend may fail at initialization.
required_behaviors: Keep a tested fallback and correct against source pixels
forbidden_behaviors: Select by reputation alone
Publish raw OCR

cases.prompt: Use a checked Vol1 reconstruction to improve later books in the same publication series while also handling an unrelated AI book.
required_behaviors: Condition profile use on series/style evidence
Derive a new profile for unrelated layouts
forbidden_behaviors: Copy gold wording
Apply Xiangshan typography blindly to every book

cases.prompt: The reference e-book spells a technical term differently from the scan. Decide which wording enters the reconstructed book.
forbidden_behaviors: Copy reference wording without source support

cases.prompt: Make labels in a diagram native while preserving arrows that cross the label boxes.
forbidden_behaviors: Erase whole OCR rectangles
Leave old labels under new text

cases.prompt: A single code line exceeds the source column after font replacement while neighboring code already matches publication style.
required_behaviors: Keep shared code point size and tone
Use bounded width fitting or reflow
forbidden_behaviors: Shrink only that line without documentation

cases.prompt: A source-backed correction forces page geometry to change. Define the regression scope.
required_behaviors: Verify boxes, order, links, outlines, extraction, and renders
forbidden_behaviors: Inspect only the edited text object

cases.prompt: Remove unnecessary intermediates after delivering the final PDF.
required_behaviors: Verify final hash before and after cleanup
Resolve exact targets and inventory survivors
forbidden_behaviors: Delete source or final artifact
Use a broad unresolved recursive target

cases.prompt: Check whether a profile learned only from 452 training pages reproduces on 98 untouched validation pages.
required_behaviors: Recompute the profile on validation pages
Compare scale, body/code faces, sizes, and tones
forbidden_behaviors: Relearn the profile from all 648 pages

cases.prompt: Classify three image-only Xiangshan scans, one scanned book with a repeated native watermark, and the checked Vol1 native reconstruction.
required_behaviors: Return sparse-native-overlay scan for the AI book
forbidden_behaviors: Infer nativity from the mere presence of any text operator

cases.prompt: Held-out OCR has low average semantic CER but nonzero punctuation CER on technical pages. Decide whether it can be published directly.
required_behaviors: Inspect every punctuation and identifier difference
Require source-backed correction to zero known errors
forbidden_behaviors: Accept raw OCR because average CER is low

cases.prompt: Source PDF MediaBoxes differ across volumes, while the accepted reconstruction follows each page image canvas at a stable publication scale.
required_behaviors: Apply the validated pixel-to-point scale per page
Recheck page boxes and downstream structure
forbidden_behaviors: Blindly copy inconsistent source MediaBoxes

cases.prompt: A complete source/candidate render comparison flags repeated watermarks, scan-edge speckles, a baseline shift, and contrast changes inside preserved figures. Decide whether the book can pass.
required_behaviors: Block true missing or altered content
forbidden_behaviors: Require zero raw band warnings without triage
Silently ignore all warnings

cases.prompt: An unrelated scanned book has native text on all text-bearing pages but intentionally retained raster covers and figures. Define the nativity gate.
required_behaviors: Distinguish body text from intentional artwork
Reopen and document image-only artwork pages
Forbid hidden OCR and raster body text
forbidden_behaviors: Reject every image-bearing page
Call a repeated watermark native body text
Leave scanned body text under replacements

cases.prompt: The corpus contains four books totaling 1,935 pages and the user requests word-by-word review. Set the review scope.
required_behaviors: Keep one row per page and every exception
Permit page-count or geometry adjustments when needed
forbidden_behaviors: Cap review at 648 pages
Substitute sampling for exhaustive review

cases.prompt: Text extraction adds a space between adjacent code runs after a font change although the render looks close.
required_behaviors: Inspect run geometry and raw strings
forbidden_behaviors: Edit semantic source text without pixel evidence

cases.prompt: All structural audits pass, but a figure caption may still be raster text.
forbidden_behaviors: Declare exact fidelity solely from clean audit summaries

cases.prompt: A one-page correction modifies a shared embedded font resource.
required_behaviors: Expand checks to the whole book
forbidden_behaviors: Assume resource changes are page-local

cases.prompt: Evaluate the frozen OCR/layout method on previously unopened Vol1 dense-code and mixed-code pages.
forbidden_behaviors: Move failed test pages into training
Claim raw OCR is final fidelity

cases.prompt: Prepare Xiangshan Vol2 and Vol3 with the Vol1-derived publication profile.
required_behaviors: Recompute per-page geometry from source pixels
Keep each volume's scan as semantic authority
forbidden_behaviors: Copy Vol1 content
Assume identical source MediaBoxes

cases.prompt: Prepare an unrelated AI book whose pages are scans with a native repeated watermark, diagrams, and QR artwork.
required_behaviors: Classify the watermark separately from body text
Preserve genuine artwork while rebuilding body text
forbidden_behaviors: Use the Xiangshan profile without evidence
Treat watermark extraction as native body content
